purpose: Evidence-led story grammar for new edits. It creates a review skeleton; it does not replace Saad's final editorial judgement.

evidence.notes: Final exports and explicitly approved timelines have priority over draft duration, root-timeline labels, unused tracks, and broad saved export ranges.

authority_order: Saad's approved final export and final correction
The explicitly named approved timeline and destination format
This grammar and closest approved family

story_first: Every shot must earn a narrative role: hook, context, action, detail, listener/reaction, transition, payoff, or resolution.
Do not use coverage merely because it is attractive or available.
A repeated person, subject, angle, or detail requires a new narrative reason.
selection: Choose the strongest usable moment inside a source clip, not automatically its first seconds.
Alternate function and scale when the story allows: wide context, human medium, detail, and reaction.
Keep imperfect but meaningful human micro-moments when they bridge the story.
A wide venue opener is useful when it establishes something the hook cannot; it is not mandatory.
transition: Hard cuts are the normal join for real-event and documentary coverage.
Use a transition only for a chapter boundary, a tonal shift, a designed premise, or the final resolve.
Slow Fade is the dominant structural transition across the library; camera-glow and graphic transitions belong only to designed occasion or commercial families.
Never apply an effect to hide weak sequencing.
sound: Choose music for cultural and emotional fit before beat density.
Retain a natural-sound moment when it adds touch, crowd, applause, a spoken line, or human presence; duck the music around it.
Picture chapters and music changes should support one another, but do not force a cut on every beat.
format: Treat every destination format as a separate editorial pass.
Reframe each selected shot for subject, gesture, headroom, and text-safe area; do not batch-crop a finished vertical or landscape master.
A separate outro or end shot may be the correct choice for a separate format.
finish: Resolve the film with a meaningful final visual, group/legacy moment, occasion card, or brand frame. Do not end on an arbitrary montage cut.
The final export is the truth. A timeline's saved export range can be stale or broader than the released video.

story_9x16.focus: native vertical composition; selective punch-ins; text-safe centre

square_1x1.focus: manual per-shot reframe; protect faces, gestures, and titles

landscape_16x9.focus: scale, environment, and balanced speaker/product composition

training_wide.focus: legible application interface and call-out-safe space

event_recap_fast.description: People-led event recap with a felt event flow rather than an inventory of activations.

speed.note: Use slow motion only where it adds premium breathing room or protects a human moment.

chapter_template.label: Hook
chapter_template.purpose: A striking human gesture, hero detail, or atmosphere that makes the viewer enter.

chapter_template.label: Arrival & context
chapter_template.purpose: Orient the viewer outside or at the venue only if the hook has not already done this.

chapter_template.label: Discover
chapter_template.purpose: People, activations, products, and atmosphere in deliberate groups.

chapter_template.label: Programme
chapter_template.purpose: Speaker/action then listener/reaction B-roll; do not stack podium shots.

chapter_template.label: Recognition / payoff
chapter_template.purpose: Certificates, shared outcome, ceremony, or emotional action.

chapter_template.label: Participation
chapter_template.purpose: An interactive ritual, collective action, or signature event moment.

chapter_template.label: Resolution
chapter_template.purpose: Group, branded final image, or story payoff that feels complete.

premium_product_event.description: Luxury event or exhibition recap where product desirability and real attendance both matter.

speed.note: Slower motion can make detail feel premium; do not slow every shot uniformly.

chapter_template.label: Hero detail
chapter_template.purpose: Statement product, model, or tactile detail.

chapter_template.label: Place
chapter_template.purpose: Venue or brand environment.

chapter_template.label: Desire
chapter_template.purpose: Product, craft, model, and customer response; alternate scale.

chapter_template.label: Event energy
chapter_template.purpose: Real interactions and exhibition atmosphere.

chapter_template.label: Signature
chapter_template.purpose: Hero close-up, branded bag/detail, then clean logo resolve.

tribute_farewell.description: People-first corporate tribute or farewell with dignity, warmth, and collective memory.

chapter_template.label: Premise
chapter_template.purpose: Legacy statement, theme, or one meaningful face.

chapter_template.label: People & place
chapter_template.purpose: Arrival, greetings, and environment.

chapter_template.label: Leadership & exchange
chapter_template.purpose: Speeches, handshakes, gifts, and reaction B-roll.

chapter_template.label: Celebration
chapter_template.purpose: Award, cake, group activities, and lived warmth.

chapter_template.label: Legacy resolve
chapter_template.purpose: Group photograph, final people moment, or title.

chapter_template.label: Brand resolve
chapter_template.purpose: Clean final brand or message.

designed_occasion_interview.description: Occasion campaign driven by a question, real testimony, visual metaphor, and a warm branded close.

speed.note: Keep testimony intelligible; cut support visuals around meaning rather than speed.

chapter_template.label: Emotional hook
chapter_template.purpose: A visual metaphor and clear question.

chapter_template.label: Testimony I
chapter_template.purpose: First value with an alternating supporting scene.

chapter_template.label: Testimony II
chapter_template.purpose: Second value with a different human image.

chapter_template.label: Testimony III
chapter_template.purpose: Third value, keeping faces personal.

chapter_template.label: Legacy
chapter_template.purpose: Collective statement and return of the opening motif.

chapter_template.label: Occasion resolve
chapter_template.purpose: Occasion message then brand.

designed_greeting.description: Short visual greeting with a single composed world, restrained text, and a quiet brand resolve.

speed.note: Let the visual breathe; this is not a montage.

chapter_template.label: Visual world
chapter_template.purpose: One hero scene establishes the occasion.

chapter_template.label: Message
chapter_template.purpose: Bilingual or occasion message remains readable.

chapter_template.label: Brand resolve
chapter_template.purpose: Logo/tagline or final minimal branded frame.

corporate_commercial.description: Concept-led commercial in which copy, voiceover, visual premise, and deliberate location changes carry the story.

speed.note: Sustain a visual long enough for the idea; do not import event-reel pacing.

chapter_template.label: Premise
chapter_template.purpose: Workplace/product context and the opening claim.

chapter_template.label: Problem
chapter_template.purpose: Show friction, constraint, or an old way of working.

chapter_template.label: Proof through variation
chapter_template.purpose: Repeat one action across deliberately different environments.

chapter_template.label: Solution
chapter_template.purpose: Product capability, platform, and comprehension beats.

chapter_template.label: Call to action
chapter_template.purpose: End card/contact path and brand.

training_tutorial.description: Screen-recorded step-by-step instruction designed for comprehension, not montage energy.

speed.note: Never speed through a readable action merely to shorten the runtime.

chapter_template.label: Title & outcome
chapter_template.purpose: State what the learner will complete.

chapter_template.label: Role / access
chapter_template.purpose: Name the role and hold the screen long enough to orient.

chapter_template.label: Guided steps
chapter_template.purpose: One action at a time: narration, screen, located call-out, then proof.

chapter_template.label: Verification
chapter_template.purpose: Show the confirmed result and any next role.

chapter_template.label: Outro
chapter_template.purpose: Clean closing animation or completion message.

instruction_rules.caption: Poppins Regular, size 5, y approximately -0.89, scale 0.75.
instruction_rules.repeated_action: Re-strike the call-out as a new short hit.
instruction_rules.role_change: Treat as a scene change with the role named and the screen stable.
instruction_rules.callout_placement: Cover the actual target control; put the label in nearby empty space; never overlap boxes.
instruction_rules.outro: Use the approved outro source, 9.1 seconds, muted, with a Slow Fade where applicable.
